description: Mt Lofty Ranges Streams – Permanent Pools or Dams Less than 15m is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment and Water. This dataset portrays all of the pools or dams with a length less than 15m visible in 3rd order streams and greater in the Mount Lofty Ranges. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment and Water. Its tags are Dams, Drainage, Pool, Surfacewater, Water. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KMZ, MAP VIEWER, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
